description: Validate a page source ({ sections: [...] }) against every element's schema. Each message reads `[CODE] #id (type) where: problem → fix`. errors block saving (duplicate/missing ids, renderer-crash shapes…); warnings render wrong (UNKNOWN_KEY invented/misspelled key, STYLE_KEY not a CSS property, TYPE_MISMATCH, BAD_VALUE outside the allowed values, BAD_PARENT, OUTSIDE_FORM, FIELD_NAME, EVENT/BINDING problems…). Repeated warnings are collapsed per code; summary.by_code counts all. Always run this before build_page and fix by code.

page_id.description: Judge it as that page's save would: its kind + the site's popups / global sources (dangling event targets and record bindings become errors)

page_kind.description: Page kind when there is no page yet (build_page type)

source.description: Page source object or JSON string

name: validate_page
